head_commit.message:
Enable analytics in codex exec and codex mcp-server (#13083)

Addresses #12913

`codex exec` was not correctly defaulting to Otel metrics to enabled 
`codex mcp-server` completely lacked an Otel collector

Summary:
- default to enabling analytics when `codex exec` initializes
OpenTelemetry so the CLI actually reports metrics again
- add a regression test that proves the flag remains enabled by default
- added Otel collector to `codex mcp-server`

head_commit.message:
Make rollout reconstruction state resumable

Replace the stored rollback count with a resumable reverse replay state that keeps the loaded rollout prefix, current history base, and visible suffix in memory. Backtracking now fully re-canonicalizes that state instead of deferring rollback as pending metadata.

Add regression coverage for rolling back past both the current suffix and a replacement-history checkpoint.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

head_commit.message:
Make rollout reconstruction state resumable

Replace the stored rollback count with a resumable reverse replay state that keeps the loaded rollout prefix, current history base, and visible suffix in memory. Backtracking now fully re-canonicalizes that state instead of deferring rollback as pending metadata.

Add regression coverage for rolling back past both the current suffix and a replacement-history checkpoint.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

head_commit.message:
fix: clear terminal when starting new session with /new

The /new command starts a fresh conversation but leaves the previous
conversation visible on screen, making the terminal cluttered. This
clears the terminal and resets UI state before starting the new session,
matching the behavior users would expect from starting fresh.

head_commit.message:
Enable analytics in codex exec and codex mcp-server (#13083)

Addresses #12913

`codex exec` was not correctly defaulting to Otel metrics to enabled 
`codex mcp-server` completely lacked an Otel collector

Summary:
- default to enabling analytics when `codex exec` initializes
OpenTelemetry so the CLI actually reports metrics again
- add a regression test that proves the flag remains enabled by default
- added Otel collector to `codex mcp-server`

head_commit.message:
fix: clear terminal when starting new session with /new

The /new command starts a fresh conversation but leaves the previous
conversation visible on screen, making the terminal cluttered. This
clears the terminal and resets UI state before starting the new session,
matching the behavior users would expect from starting fresh.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
